items.title: Mozambique’s Sovereign Fund focused on intergenerational wealth creation – minister
items.summary: “The Mozambican Government’s objective is indeed to ensure that revenue from natural gas can generate intergenerational wealth,” Finance Minister Carla Loveira told Lusa in an interview According to the minister, the Sovereign Wealth Fund Law is already producing tangible results by establishing a division of LNG revenue between public expenditure and savings “We do not want all the resources to be entirely consumed by the current budget,” she said Under the model currently in force, around 60% of revenue is channelled to the State Budget, while the remaining 40% goes into a savings account managed by the Bank of Mozambique According to the minister, the funds are already financing major infrastructure projects “Gas revenue is already being channelled into resilient infrastructure, such as roads, schools, bridges and hospitals,” she said Loveira said that US$109 million (€97.22 million) was allocated to the Sovereign Wealth Fund’s savings component in 2025 “Today, the Sovereign Wealth Fund already has a balance of US$151 million (€134.68 million),” she said According to the…

items.title: Self-replicating AI: Is your fridge a cybersecurity risk?
items.summary: Anthropic researchers warn that AI worms could soon target connected household devices and spread from one device to another. Cyberattacks on French supermarkets illustrate just how vulnerable such systems can be In the living room, a robot vacuum cleaner moves back and forth, the lights are dimmed by voice assistants, the heating is controlled via smartphone and the TV connects to the internet to access a favorite streaming service. These are all examples of the "Internet of Things," in which connected electronic devices exchange data and communicate with one another According to recent market research by industry association Bitkom , about half of all households in Germany use such or similar "smart home" applications — and the figure is rising Now, the artificial intelligence company Anthropic has published a report warning that AI-powered malware could soon infiltrate connected household devices, copy itself to other devices and become active there Computer viruses that copy themselves from one machine to another have existed for decades.

items.title: Letters with 'suspicious substances' sent to US senators and election offices
items.summary: Federal authorities say they are investigating "potentially hazardous" letters containing "suspicious substances" that have been sent to congressional and state election offices around the US The FBI and the US Postal Inspection Service (USPIS) said they were trying to trace the "suspicious mailings", some of which were intercepted before they were received Authorities declined to say how many offices had been targeted, but several secretaries of state and congressional offices reported receiving the letters Coming just weeks before the US midterm elections, it echoes previous security scares involving suspicious mail The suspicious letters were sent to at least five Democratic senators' offices, most of which were intercepted before delivery, the BBC's US partner CBS News reported They were Delaware's Lisa Blunt Rochester, California's Alex Padilla, and the two senators for New York, Chuck Schumer and Kirsten Gillibrand, CBS reported Connecticut Democrat Chris Murphy was also sent a letter containing a suspicious substance, which was intercepted before reaching the office, his…

items.title: Baku hosted 7th CICA Summit President Ilham Aliyev addressed the event
items.summary: Maputo, October 15, AIM/AZERTAC – On October 15, the 7th Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA) was held in Baku. President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev welcomed the heads of state and government attending the event. Opening the summit, President of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev said: – Esteemed heads of state and government, Distinguished heads of delegations, Ladies and gentlemen, I am pleased to welcome you to Baku for the 7th Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA). I express my gratitude to all of you for accepting our invitation. I declare the 7th Summit of Heads of State and Government of CICA open. First of all, we must approve the agenda.

items.title: Mozambique: President wants BPI stake in BCI to stay in domestic hands — Lusa report
items.summary: “Mozambique’s government has been seeking to create the conditions so that the 36% stake currently held by BPI presents an opportunity to broaden the participation of Mozambican investors, including citizens, companies and institutional investors, while complying with the legally required procedures for valuation, negotiation and authorisation,” stated Daniel Chapo At the ceremony marking the 28th anniversary of the Mozambique Stock Exchange in Maputo, the president said the government is working to turn the sale of the Portuguese bank’s stake into an opportunity to expand Mozambican investors’ presence in the country’s largest bank BCI has a share capital of 10 billion meticais (€138 million) and a shareholder structure led by Caixa Participações, part of the Caixa Geral de Depósitos (CGD) group, with a 51% stake, followed by the Portuguese bank BPI, with 35.67%, which has publicly announced its intention to exit, and CGD itself, holding a direct stake of 10.51%, among other shareholders It is essential that, «soon», Mozambicans can say BCI «is now truly local», in reference to the…

items.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
items.summary: Thirteen US soldiers were killed in a shooting rampage at Fort Hood in Texas US President Donald Trump has called off plans to livestream the execution of former US army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan by firing squad Trump had previously said he approved of showing the death of the Fort Hood attacker, while Vice-President JD Vance cast doubt on whether it would happen and said he would not watch it Trump's decision to cancel the livestream came after widespread criticism in the US and globally. On Thursday, he said that "many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die" "I think streaming the execution for all to see might have been a strong deterrent for the World to witness how America deals with Terrorists and SCUM like Hasan," Trump said "He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed," the president added in Hasan fatally shot 13 unarmed US military personnel and injured 32 others at a military base in Texas in 2009.

items.title: Zimbabwean author denies using AI to write award-winning story
items.summary: Simbarashe Kundizeza says he was inspired by a poem about fish tanks to write a story about his family struggles in Zimbabwe Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied using artificial intelligence (AI) to write his short story, which won this year's Caine Prize for African Writing His statement comes a week after he scooped the £10,000 ($13,000) award and a recent article in The Atlantic said AI-detection software Pangram had shown his work about a boy whose family falls on hard times was entirely AI generated "For the avoidance of doubt, I wrote The Blue Fighter," he posted on X , external The accusation has caused an uproar on social media and Caine Prize chair Ellah Wakatama told the BBC she was shocked that the US magazine had not waited for a full investigation before publishing "I do wish The Atlantic had spent more time investigating this so that alongside Pangram, they did have evidence of real human investigation of it before tainting the prize and tainting this winner," Wakatama told the BBC's Front Row programme The chair of the Caine Prize's board of trustees…
